tool.name: mumemto viz
tool.description: Visualize pangenome synteny from multi-MUM output
tool.command: ## Symlink mums and lengths files to matching prefixes so viz can find them ln -s '$mum_file' viz_input.mums && ln -s '$lengths_file' viz_input.lengths && mumemto viz -m viz_input.mums -l viz_input.lengths -o 'viz_output' #if $interactive: --interactive #end if && ## Rename outputs to Galaxy-expected names #if $interactive: mv 'viz_output.html' '$interactive_output' #else: mv 'viz_output.png' '$plot_output' #end if

param.name: mum_file
param.label: Input .mums file
param.help: Multi-MUM output from mumemto find (strict or partial multi-MUMs only)

param.name: lengths_file
param.label: Input .lengths file
param.help: Sequence lengths file from the same mumemto find run

param.name: interactive
param.label: Generate interactive plotly plot
param.help: Experimental: produces an interactive HTML plot instead of a static PNG

tool.help:
# mumemto viz
Generates synteny visualization plots from multi-MUM output files.
## Input
Provide a `.mums` file and the corresponding `.lengths` file, both produced by **mumemto find**. The visualization shows the positions of multi-MUMs across all input sequences, highlighting regions of synteny and potential structural variation.
Only strict and partial multi-MUMs are supported for visualization (a `.mums` file is required, not a `.mems` file).
## Options
- **Interactive plot:** Generate an interactive plotly HTML plot instead of a static PNG (experimental). This allows zooming, panning, and hovering over individual matches for detailed inspection.
## Output
- A static PNG synteny plot (default), or - An interactive HTML plot (with interactive mode enabled).
For detailed usage, see the [Mumemto wiki](https://github.com/vikshiv/mumemto/wiki).
